## SOC EF (delta SOC) for Canada

We are using the RF model (5-y moving average) to estimate SOC changes from crop C input



```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
source("setup.R")
load("Output/Model_5.RData") # ML model from 5-y moving average.
SiteData <- read_rds("Input/Canada Cinput_5y.rds") %>%
            mutate(TEXT = case_when(
            TEXCAT == "fine"      ~ 3,
            TEXCAT == "medium"    ~ 2,
            TEXCAT == "coarse"    ~ 1,
            TRUE                   ~NA_integer_
               ))
  
```

## SOC change prediction

county level first and aggregate to state level

```{r}
#County level data
SiteData$SOC_predict <- predict(rf_model, newdata = SiteData)

# Aggregated to Region level (Atlantic provinces)
SiteData <- SiteData %>%
  mutate(Region = ifelse(
    Province_ID %in% c("NB","NF","NS","PE"), "AT", Province_ID
  )) %>%
  filter(CROPS %in% c("BARLEY", "CANOLA", "CORNGR", "CORNSLG", "DFPEAS",
         "RYEFAL", "WHTSPG", "SOYBNS", "WHTDUR", "WHTWINT",
         "TRITCL", "RYESPG")) %>%
  mutate(CROP = case_when(
     CROPS == "BARLEY"     ~ "Barley",
     CROPS == "CANOLA"     ~ "Canola",
     CROPS == "CORNGR"     ~ "Corn",
     CROPS == "CORNSLG"    ~ "Corn",
     CROPS == "DFPEAS"     ~ "Peas",
     CROPS == "RYEFAL"     ~ "RYE",
     CROPS == "RYESPG"     ~ "RYE",
     CROPS == "WHTSPG"     ~ "Wheat(spring)",
     CROPS == "SOYBNS"     ~ "Soybeans",
     CROPS == "WHTDUR"     ~ "Wheat(durum)",
     CROPS == "WHTWINT"    ~ "Wheat(winter)",
     CROPS == "TRITCL"     ~ "Triticale",
     TRUE                  ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  mutate(UTIL = case_when(
     CROPS == "CORNGR"     ~ "Grain",
     CROPS == "CORNSLG"    ~ "Sliage",
     TRUE                  ~ "All production"
  ))

#helper for weighted means that gracefully handles all-NA cases
w_mean <- function(x, w) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) return(NA_real_)
  weighted.mean(x, w, na.rm = TRUE)
}

#obtain weighted values and simple average
SiteData_CA <- SiteData %>% 
  mutate(area_w = AREA * Frac / 100) %>%          # weight column once
  group_by(Region, CROP, UTIL) %>% 
  summarise(
    across(
      c(Cinput, MAT, MAP, MPE, CARB30, SOC_predict),
      list(avg  = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
           wavg = ~w_mean(.x, area_w)),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"                              # remove grouping (optional)
  ) %>%
  select(Region, CROP, Cinput_wavg, MAT_wavg, MAP_wavg, MPE_wavg, CARB30_wavg,SOC_predict_wavg)

summary(SiteData_CA) # SOC_predict_wavg, median 0.12559, mean 0.12669, min -0.06113 t/ha
#write.csv(SiteData_CA, "Output/1. SOC_Cinput_EF_Canada_WO Silage.csv", row.names = FALSE)

#obtain weighted values and simple average, Silage and grain aggregated
SiteData_CA <- SiteData %>% 
  mutate(area_w = AREA * Frac / 100) %>%          # weight column once
  group_by(Region, CROP) %>% 
  summarise(
    across(
      c(Cinput, MAT, MAP, MPE, CARB30, SOC_predict),
      list(avg  = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
           wavg = ~w_mean(.x, area_w)),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"                              # remove grouping (optional)
  ) %>%
  select(Region, CROP, Cinput_wavg, MAT_wavg, MAP_wavg, MPE_wavg, CARB30_wavg,SOC_predict_wavg)

summary(SiteData_CA) # SOC_predict_wavg, median 0.12436, mean 0.12345, min -0.06113 t/ha
#write.csv(SiteData_CA, "Output/1. SOC_Cinput_EF_Canada.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
